name: Rippling
summary: An all-in-one workforce platform (HR, payroll, IT, spend) on one employee record. Rippling AI answers questions and runs tasks over that record; for outside clients the vendor runs a first-party MCP server governed by an MCP Gateway, exposing a single code tool whose typed functions include ask_ai, people and org lookups, time-off balances and requests, draft hires and custom objects. Writes enter the product's normal approval flows and a hire creates a draft for human review. Account-bound: it answered 401 to a probe with no credentials, and tool calls need an active Rippling AI subscription.

payments.notes: 2026-09-26: no surface prices an MCP call; keyless initialize draws 401 Bearer, not 402. Customer Terms (2026-07-02): fees per Order Form, auto-debited from a stored bank account or other funding source; no card-on-file route shown for this subscription; most products per employee per month.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-26, no credentials, identical: POST mcp.rippling.com/mcp answers 401 Bearer naming a resource_metadata URL that is itself 403 to a datacenter IP. Vendor: employee identity, an admin access assignment and a Rippling AI subscription are all required.

jobs.summary: Vendor's words: "Automate the way you approve invoices", "Dedupe bills automatically", "Sync bills to your general ledger", and pay "vendors and contractors internationally in their local currency" by ACH, check, wire or virtual card. Nothing asserts payment by the due date. Not measured.

Vendor's words: "Payroll software that runs accurately and on time—every time"; it will "file them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies at precisely the right time"; employees "view pay stubs and tax forms at any time". net, social contributions, provider remittance: 0. Not measured.

Vendor's words: "generate invoices automatically, route approvals, and pay contractors in 50+ currencies", "15+ payout options including Wise, Revolut, instant transfers, stablecoin, debit card". No verified destination, no fee or exchange rate shown to the recipient. Not measured.

Vendor: Rippling "automatically provisions or revokes access based on role changes, risk signals, and company policy", enforces rules "across provisioning, approvals, license reclamation, and offboarding", and will "Instantly reclaim inactive licenses". No same-day or audit sentence. Not measured.
